Name: Juice Cider and Root Beer
Author: FarmerBriar
Description:
[size=3]Because I'm not a fan of alcohol, I made this mod to change beverages in-game. Besides the fact that the vanilla beverages are good for little more than selling due to the negative buffs, I feel that juice and sparkling cider fits better with the farming environment. This mod changes all alcohol and eliminates the negative effects of the tipsy debuff when consuming beverages. [/size]

[b][size=4]Compatibility:[/size][/b]
[size=3]If you are [/size]using[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5394] Better[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4912] Crops and Foraging[/url] or[size=3] [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5394]Better Artisan Goods[/url][size=3] by cometkins make sure that "Hops" and "Beer" are [/size][b]unchecked[/b][size=3] in the config menus.[/size]


[size=3]CHANGES:[/size]
This mod overhauls the following:
[list]
[*]Beer → Root Beer
[*]Wine → Juice or Cider
[*]Pale Ale → Spiced Apple Cider
[*]Hops → Cortland apples
[*]Mead → Oxymel
[*]No more tipsy debuff
[*]Roots now make root beer
[*]Wheat makes muscle remedy
[/list]

_ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _[size=3]

[/size][b][size=4]Credit:
[/size][/b]A special thanks to rokugin and the stardew valley discord server for the Never Tipsy code!


[b][size=4]Note:
[/size][/b]If you like this mod, check out [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29043]Coffee to Hot Cocoa - Rename[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29113]Coffee to Hot Cocoa - Reskin[/url]
